text:
Kevin: Heads-up — we need one short decision for audit event naming that teams can adopt by EOD. RBAC changes are landing this week and KMS integration surfaces a few new actor fields. Can we pick one taxonomy pattern?
Sara: agree. current problem: product events use snake_case_action, infra uses dot.prefixed, and some teams add service prefixes. it's a mess.
Maria: proposal: <domain>.<resource>.<action> e.g. auth.user.update, kms.key.rotate. dotted, lowercase, no verbs in past tense. keeps grouping clear.
Jonathan: would that break existing consumers? we have to support backwards compatibility for logs sent to SIEMs.
Linda: we should version the event namespace: v1 before the dot? like v1.auth.user.update — makes migration explicit.
Kevin: good point. Maria's pattern + optional version prefix seems fine. we should publish a compatibility shim in the ingest pipeline for 30 days.
Maria: +1. also recommend a short display_name field for customer-facing views (human readable), separate from the event name used in telemetry. e.g. display_name: "User profile updated"
Security-ops: recommend including actor.type and actor.id fields in every event (RBAC) and kms.key_id for KMS events. schema must require provenance fields.
Kevin: can we add a minimal JSON snippet for the spec?
Sara: paste here:
```
{
  "event": "v1.auth.user.update",
  "display_name": "User profile updated",
  "timestamp": "2026-03-20T15:12:00Z",
  "actor": { "type": "user|service|machine", "id": "user-1234" },
  "resource": { "type": "user", "id": "user-1234" },
  "metadata": { "ip": "1.2.3.4" }
}
```
Jonathan: LGTM. for SIEM/backwards-compat we can add a transform: map old_name->event and keep old_name as legacy_event for 90 days. ops to implement.
Maria: also call out what counts as "customer-facing" vs internal: customer-facing events must not contain PII in top-level fields. use pointers (resource.id) only if hashed.
Linda: we need a short rollout plan in the doc: 1) publish spec, 2) lint rule in CI that enforces dotted format, 3) pipeline transform for legacy, 4) 30/90 day deprecation windows, 5) inform customers via changelog.
Kevin: volunteers for the spec PR and lint rule?
Maria: I'll draft the spec PR (with examples) by tomorrow morning.
Sara: I'll add the lint rule to the event-sdk repo and a unit test.
Jonathan: I'll own the ingest shim and the 90-day mapping table.
Linda: I'll draft the rollout checklist and customer note.
audit-bot: New audit rule suggested: require actor.* and event fields for all write operations. Added to backlog #A-431.
Kevin: solid. next sync Friday 10am to sign off. if anyone finds edge cases (batch events, deduped webhooks, delegated actions) add them here.
Maria: edge case: delegated ops where actor is a service acting on behalf of user — include delegation.chain array (max 3) with limited fields. small note in spec.
Sara: noted. I'll add CI check to ensure delegation.chain length <=3.
Jonathan: one more ops concern: KMS events may include key rotation metadata — ensure we never log raw key material, only key_id and rotation_reason.
Kevin: agreed. ok everyone, thanks — I'll open a short confluence page with the draft spec and link the PRs. :thumbsup:
